title: 第1555章 柳立晨的谋划落空第1554章 与柴艳合作
slug: 剑道圣体的我只想躺平
content_zh:
“到时候保证立一大功，让你那十几头异兽都能饱餐一顿。”
花不羁点头，眼中闪着兴奋的光：“那就好！我这几日正好把兽群喂得精壮。”
这时蓝采儿从苗诗烟的房子走出来，手里端着一碗药渣，看到秦峰回来了。
她擦了擦额头的细汗，语气透着凝重：“苗姑娘的伤势不轻。”
“恐怕要养一个月才能恢复，不过好在没有伤及根本，她底子不错。”
“我已经用了七虫续骨膏，又熬了回元汤，只要静养，便不会留下暗疾。”
秦峰点了点头，目光望向碎魂谷的方向，沉沉道：“你最近多留意一下碎魂谷方向。”
“那边的迷雾每日子时和午时会变薄，若有人穿行，必有飞鸟惊散。”
“如果有动静，立刻来通知我，成败在此一举。”
蓝采儿应道：“好的，没问题，我在谷口放了不少蛊虫，一旦有异动，我便能察觉。”
一晃过了三天时间，柴艳每天都去找汤玉辉那里，说要严防碎魂谷。
她每次带着地形图，指着碎魂谷的隘口，陈述利害，嗓音洪亮，条理分明。
汤玉辉每次都给搪塞过去，各种借口层出不穷，丝毫不当回事。
然而这几次柴艳却没有像之前一样愤怒，顶撞汤玉辉，拍桌子骂人。
而是表现出一种无力感，黯然的离开，垂头丧气，连背影都透着落寞。
让汤玉辉都有些摸不着头脑，私下问亲信：“柴艳这几日怎么转性了？”
亲信也说不上来，只道或许是她认命了，汤玉辉便得意地哼起小曲。
又过两天，蓝采儿终于传来了消息。
她飞身掠到院中，急促道：“祈灵神朝的一批精锐正准备通过碎魂谷绕到镇邪关后方。”
“约莫十多人，但为首者气息极强，可能有神君级强者，速度极快。”

秦峰立刻将这个消息告诉了柴艳，柴艳顿时面露兴奋，眼中迸出凌厉的战意：“终于来了吗！”
为了不惊动汤玉辉，柴艳并没有调用其他人，只点了秦峰，花不羁，蓝采儿三人跟随。
她甚至连自己的亲卫队都没带，怕人多嘴杂走漏风声，坏了大事。
不过这也够了，因为碎魂谷环境特殊，对魂魄有种撕裂感，普通的护卫去了也没有用。
寻常真神境进去，半个时辰便头痛欲裂，战力大减。
碎魂谷深处，柳立晨带着十几号精锐向着镇邪关而去，步履谨慎，队形严密。
他这次得到了布防图，反复推演了七遍，认定从这里过去是对方最薄弱的位置。
只要穿出谷口，便能直插镇邪关后方，打开城门，里应外合，此战必胜！
为了万无一失，他还请动了神朝中的烈阳神君，这位老牌神君修炼烈阳真火。
一手焚天掌能熔金化石，这次的偷袭可以说是万无一失，他信心满满。
他一边走一边安排，声音压低却带着不容置疑的威严：“等下绕到了镇邪关后方。”
“不要恋战，第一时间去打开城门，放我方精锐入城。”
然后看向队伍中一名老者，躬身道：“烈阳前辈，如果出现神君强者，还请帮忙抵挡一二。”
content_en:
"I promise to make a great contribution when the time comes, so that your dozens of strange beasts can have a full meal."
Hua Buzhi nodded, his eyes shining with excitement: "That's good! I've been feeding the beasts well these past few days."
At this time, Lan Cai'er walked out of Miao Shiyan's house, holding a bowl of medicine residue in her hand, and saw Qin Feng coming back.
She wiped the sweat from her forehead and said with a solemn tone, "Miss Miao's injury is not serious."
"I'm afraid it will take a month to recover, but fortunately it didn't damage her roots. She has a good foundation."
"I have used Qi Chong Xu Gu Ointment and boiled Hui Yuan Decoction. As long as I rest and rest, there will be no hidden diseases."
Qin Feng nodded, looked in the direction of Broken Soul Valley, and said solemnly: "You should pay more attention to the direction of Broken Soul Valley recently."
"The fog there will become thinner every day and noon. If anyone walks through it, the birds will scatter."
"If there is any movement, please notify me immediately. Success or failure depends on this."
Lan Cai'er responded: "Okay, no problem. I put a lot of Gu insects at the entrance of the valley. If there is any abnormal movement, I will be able to detect it."
Three days later, Chai Yan went to Tang Yuhui every day and told him to be on guard against Broken Soul Valley.
Every time she brought a topographic map, pointed to the pass of Broken Soul Valley, and stated the pros and cons, her voice was loud and clear.
Tang Yuhui was always excused, with all kinds of excuses coming out one after another, and he didn't take it seriously at all.
However, these few times, Chai Yan was not as angry as before, contradicting Tang Yuhui, slamming the table and swearing.
Instead, he showed a sense of powerlessness and left sadly, dejected, even his back looked lonely.
Tang Yuhui was a little confused and asked his confidants privately: "Why did Chai Yan change her gender in the past few days?"
The confidants couldn't tell, but they could only say that maybe she had accepted her fate, and Tang Yuhui hummed a ditty proudly.
Two days later, news finally came from Lan Cai'er.
She flew into the courtyard and said hurriedly: "A group of elites from the Spirit-Praying Dynasty are preparing to pass through the Broken Soul Valley to the back of the Evil Suppressing Pass."
"There are about a dozen people, but the leader's aura is very strong. He may be a god-level expert, and he is extremely fast."
Qin Feng immediately told Chai Yan the news, and Chai Yan suddenly looked excited, with a fierce fighting spirit in her eyes: "Is it finally here?"
In order not to alarm Tang Yuhui, Chai Yan did not call anyone else, but only ordered Qin Feng, Hua Buzhi, and Lan Cai'er to follow.
She didn't even bring her own bodyguards with her, for fear that gossip would spread the rumors and spoil the matter.
But this is enough, because the Soul Broken Valley has a special environment that can tear apart the soul, so ordinary guards are of no use.
Normally, after entering the True God Realm, he would have a splitting headache within half an hour and his combat power would be greatly reduced.
Deep in the Broken Soul Valley, Liu Lichen led a dozen elites toward Zhenxie Pass, walking cautiously and forming a tight formation.
This time he got the defense map and rehearsed it seven times, deciding that this was the opponent's weakest position.
As long as you pass through the valley entrance, you can go straight to the back of Zhenxie Pass, open the city gate, and cooperate with the inside and the outside. This battle will be won!
In order to be sure, he also invited the Lord Lieyang of the Divine Dynasty. This veteran Lord of God cultivated the True Fire of Lieyang.
The Burning Heaven Palm in one hand can melt gold fossils. This sneak attack can be said to be foolproof, and he is full of confidence.
He made arrangements as he walked, his voice low but with unquestionable majesty: "We will go around to the back of Zhenxie Pass later."
"Don't be obsessed with fighting. Open the city gate as soon as possible and let our elite enter the city."
Then he looked at an old man in the team, bowed and said: "Senior Lieyang, if a powerful divine king appears, please help to resist him."
